submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 with a threshold of 34 GeV achieves the highest signal efficiency of 92.762% at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate. This configuration was identified through systematic simulation across all three candidate algorithms and threshold values ranging from 20 to 50 GeV. Algorithm-L2 (iterative topological clustering with learned calibration) consistently outperforms Algorithm-L3 (sliding-window clustering, ~86% efficiency) and Algorithm-L1 (fixed-window sum, ~74% efficiency) across all tested thresholds. The optimal threshold of 34 GeV provides marginally better performance than the previously studied 35 GeV threshold (92.586%), representing a data-driven optimization of the trigger configuration within the allowed parameter space.
